_basis: Apples-to-apples final sweep: 7 configs x 3 seeds x 40 epochs, leak-free protocol (pipeline/leakfree.py), player-level split, rebuilt matrix (120 features / 17 towers). The deployed v4 recipe was measured INSIDE the same sweep as a_v4_ctrl.

_evidence.objective: train_mtnn.promotion_composite = 0.4*recall + 0.6*purity (the repo's own gate; next-profile RMSE is in NO gate)
_evidence.note_top4_tied: fh384_d48 (0.7949), hb128_d48 (0.7937), b3_h224_t48_d64 (0.7930), b2_h160_t32_d96 (0.7908) span 0.0041 against half-spreads of 0.0029-0.0063 -- statistically indistinguishable. hb128_d48 chosen as the cheapest of the tied leaders: best recall of the group, d_emb 48 (zero migration), and no new architectural knob. fh384_d48 is hb128_d48 + fusion_hidden 384; that edge was 0.0045 at one seed and 0.0012 across three.
_evidence.note_transformer: tx_b2_h160_t32_d64: recall 0.991 (highest ever measured) but purity 0.6308 (lowest). Composite 0.7750, i.e. 0.0096 BELOW v4 against +/-0.0063 noise -- significantly worse, not a tie. Cross-tower attention individuates (nails player identity) at the cost of typifying (cross-era archetype structure). SHIP_C rejected on valid evidence.
_evidence.note_scaling: b3_h224_t48_d64 at 1,290,027 params ties hb128_d48 at 528,315. Parameter scaling buys nothing on this data.
